name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) is a crop insurance scheme that provides financial protection to farmers against crop loss due to natural disasters, pests, and diseases.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
department: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers' Welfare
benefits: Provides financial assistance to farmers suffering crop damage or loss arising from unforeseen events.
Provides crop insurance coverage against specified natural disasters, pests, and diseases.

Maximum farmer premium is 2% for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for yearly commercial or horticultural crops, with the remaining premium subsidized by the government.
Provides coverage for prevented sowing, with indemnity claims of up to a maximum of 25% of the sum insured in eligible cases.
Provides post-harvest loss coverage for eligible crops for up to 14 days after harvesting when stored in cut-and-spread condition.
Provides coverage for specified localized calamities such as hailstorms, landslides, and inundation.
Uses technologies such as satellite imaging, drones, and mobile applications for crop-loss estimation and claim settlement.

rules.description: Applicant must be a farmer, including a tenant farmer or sharecropper, growing a notified crop in a notified area.
The farmer must be growing a crop notified under the scheme.
The insured crop must be grown in an area notified under PMFBY.
The farmer must have an insurable interest in the insured crop.
The farmer must be a cultivator or sharecropper on the insured land.
The farmer must possess a valid and authenticated land ownership certificate or valid land tenure agreement.
The farmer must apply for insurance coverage within the prescribed timeframe.

exclusion_rules.description: Crop losses in non-notified areas are generally not covered under PMFBY.
Crop losses occurring outside the specified crop cycle may be excluded from coverage.
Losses resulting from farmer negligence or non-compliance with recommended agricultural practices may be excluded.
Losses beyond specified limits or thresholds may not be covered.
Failure to pay the required farmer premium contribution may result in loss of coverage.
Farmers must not have received compensation for the same crop loss from another medium or source.

documents.description: Passport-sized photograph is listed among the required documents.
Bank passbook is listed among the required documents.
Accepted identity proof may include Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Bank Passbook with Photo, Kisan Photo Book or NREGA Job Card.
Accepted address proof may include Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Electricity Bill or Bank Passbook with Photo.
Evidence of land records such as State Records of Right, Land Possession Certificate and applicable agreements or contracts is required.

documents.document_name: Declaration about Crop Sown or Intended to be Sown
documents.description: A declaration about the crop sown or intended to be sown is required.

tutorial_steps.title: Open the PMFBY portal
tutorial_steps.description: Visit the official Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana website.

tutorial_steps.title: Open Farmer Corner
tutorial_steps.description: Click Farmer Corner on the PMFBY homepage and select Guest Farmer to open the online registration form.

tutorial_steps.title: Complete farmer registration
tutorial_steps.description: Enter the mandatory farmer, residential, farmer ID and bank account details, then complete the captcha and create the user account.

tutorial_steps.title: Open crop insurance application
tutorial_steps.description: After successful registration, select Farmer Corner and choose Apply for Crop Insurance Yourself, then log in using the farmer login.

tutorial_steps.title: Authenticate with OTP
tutorial_steps.description: Enter the registered mobile number, request an OTP, enter the OTP and submit to open the Farmer Application Form.

tutorial_steps.title: Complete application and upload documents
tutorial_steps.description: Fill all mandatory application fields and upload the required documents in the specified format and size.

tutorial_steps.title: Review and submit
tutorial_steps.description: Preview the application and uploaded documents, then submit the application.

tutorial_steps.title: Pay the premium
tutorial_steps.description: Choose Pay Later or Make Payment. After successful payment, the payment receipt can be printed.

tutorial_steps.title: Track application
tutorial_steps.description: Use the Application Status option on the PMFBY website to track the application.
